Sample: 0d93035673c3f2ddbad70057bf479b24195a2073fa5e9d9a9af95202bc895429
Verdict: hostile Linux x86-64 MeshAgent deployer.

Analysis used cleave facts and rizin disassembly, without executing the sample
or fetching its remote payloads. Addresses below are virtual addresses in the
submitted ELF. The complete executable LOAD segment survives, although the file
ends at 65536 bytes and its section-header table extends beyond EOF. This alone
does not establish deliberate anti-analysis. The installed engine's built-in
anti-analysis/malformed/elf-header finding is a pre-existing classification
limitation; the new hostile rules do not consume it.

Main starts at 0x401030 (rizin includes it inside fcn.00401010).
0x4010aa-0x4011b9 downloads an encrypted ZIP using wget and extracts it with
unzip -o -P into /tmp. It deletes the ZIP and chmods the agent 0755.
0x4012xx-0x40134e fetches YouTube commentThreads JSON and passes it to the
parser at 0x401ef0. That parser searches quoted textOriginal values and calls
0x401d90 to extract a domain candidate. The extractor scans hostname characters
and requires domain punctuation and alphabetic content; it is not command eval.
If no domain is recovered, 0x401368 calls the Google Drive fallback at 0x402000,
which downloads a text file, trims whitespace, and copies the address into the
same output buffer. The downloaded intermediate files are unlinked.
0x401569-0x401571 passes meshagent.msh and that domain buffer to 0x402220.
0x402220 replaces PUT_DOMAIN_HERE in the configuration and writes it back.
0x4017b8-0x401880 double-forks, calls setsid, changes to /tmp, redirects output
to meshagent.log, and executes stdbuf -oL with the agent executable as argument.
0x402430 polls the agent PID and reads its log for Connected. for up to 30s.
0x40170b-0x40175c unlinks the connected agent's executable, configuration,
database, log and IPC artifact while keeping the agent process running.
0x401761-0x4017b3 checks its liveness every 30s and redeploys after death.
Failed deployments back off from 60s to 600s. Subsequent deployment cycles
pkill existing instances and replace the agent.

0x4019d0 obtains the hostname, constructs JSON containing pcName, eventType,
and message, and double-forks wget --post-data to an HTTPS Cloud Run endpoint.
This is deployment telemetry. It is not evidence of credential theft.
Other user-defined helpers cover synchronous fork/exec/wait, file reading,
domain extraction, configuration replacement, and failure cleanup; the rest of
the recovered native functions are predominantly statically linked musl.

YouTube comments are a C2 address rendezvous, rather than a demonstrated
command channel. MeshAgent handles subsequent remote control. The remote ZIP
and live server behavior were not inspected.

New coverage separates YouTube resolution, Drive resolution, deletion of a
live agent's files, and detached execution of the concealed agent. Findings
describe static co-occurrence rather than claiming engine-proven value flow.
Neither original video/Drive IDs, API key, password, endpoint hostname, sample
hash, size, nor staged basename is required. Diagnostic wording remains one
coverage limitation: removing all semantic diagnostics requires other rules.

verify.py builds inert ELF fixtures. It checks both-source and single-source
variants, renamed identifiers and equivalent wording, ordinary API references,
ordinary agent cleanup, missing required evidence, and absent syscall roles.
Run: python3 testdata/triage/youtube-drive-agent/verify.py /tmp/agent-controls
